name: Kaimana Silva
bio:
Kaimana is a contemporary artist living and working on Oahu. He found his passion working with traditional Hawaiian materials and methods but puts a modern spin on them. He's fiercely independent, having built his career from the ground up, yet he thrives in social settings, always drawn to the energy of creative spaces and the stories of the people within them. 

He’s looking for someone who appreciates his artistic vision and understands the dedication it requires. While he enjoys a comfortable lifestyle, he values genuine connection and shared experiences over material possessions. He's not interested in marriage or children, but he does crave deep conversations and quality time with a partner who is equally passionate about their own pursuits.

physical.description: Kaimana has a strong, athletic build from years of surfing. He has a distinctive birthmark just above his left eyebrow that adds to his rugged charm.

meetingContext: At an art gallery opening sponsored by one of your team's partners.
firstImpression: You immediately notice his captivating smile and the genuine warmth in his dark eyes as he gestures animatedly while discussing a piece of art.
loveLanguage: Quality Time: He expresses his love through shared experiences, deep conversations, and undivided attention. He values moments of genuine connection and appreciates it when his partner actively participates in his life and interests.
